dedupe_keys.name: hostile eco uk energy events corpus

description: This is a curated data set of significant events affecting the UK energy system, each cited to primary sources. It is published by Gareth Ellis for hostile.eco, where the events feed views and feeds on the site. It lists 56 events from January 2004 to November 2025 across seven categories (policy, infrastructure, geopolitical, market, weather, demand and milestone), 54 in Great Britain and two German comparators, graded 32 major, 16 pivotal and 8 notable. Each row has a fixed-taxonomy category, severity tier, occurrence range, country, at least one of 85 source URLs and a methodology note, and the provider states that all source URLs resolved on 25 August 2026. Coverage is Great Britain over two decades. Files are a CSV, a YAML file and a README on Zenodo (version 0.14.0, August 2026) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: it is a small, curated selection by one author, not a complete incident register. Simulation uses are timelines and context for resilience and market studies of the GB energy system. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
